title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 119 (Rwai Lum bad Wah Vol. 17)
khasi_title: Rwai Lum bad Wah Ba-paka No. 119
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ki lum ba pyngngad ka ri,
Sawa ka sur ba thiang tam;
Ki sim ki rwai halor ki tnat,
Ban pyndap ia ka dohnud da ka jingsuk.
lyrics_english:
Across the cool mountain ranges of our land,
Resounds the sweetest melody of all;
The birds sing atop green boughs,
Filling our hearts with enduring peace.
